posts.title: Good Children Say Grace
posts.description: Good Children Say Grace (USD$6.99) by Denis Morozov, Milha Vek Spend a day with Martin and Amelia on a remote Eastern European island in this absurdist psychological horror adventure. Your conversations and movements shape the events of the day, where every decision counts. Buy for USD$6.99 on itch.io

posts.title: Pulcra Remastered
posts.description: Pulcra Remastered by vikintor Explore a claustrophobic maze of flesh, collect ten scattered sigils, and fight back against the many things stalking you. I love the horrifying and grimy visuals, gory in all the right ways. Download on itch.io
